column3: Close to the Hebrew; כּוּשׁ (“Cush”) is rendered “Ethiopia,” and “will make its hands run” “will quickly stretch out her hands.”
Close to the Hebrew; גַּאֲוָתוֹ (“his majesty”) is rendered “His excellence.”
Close to the Hebrew; “awesome is God from your sanctuaries” is rendered “You are more awesome than Your holy places.”
